title: VerificationResult
description: Schema for atomic verification results produced by the verification cascade (§10, DEC-018, DEC-019)

verification_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this verification verdict (UUID)

claim_id.description: Foreign key to the verified Claim

label.description: Final verification label assigned to the claim

stage_reached.description: Final cascade stage that assigned the verdict (A: Deterministic, B: ModernBERT/NLI, C: LLM Judge)

stage_a_label.description: Verdict from Stage A deterministic rules; null if Stage A not applicable

stage_b_label.description: Verdict from Stage B learned NLI classifier; null if bypassed or not reached

stage_b_raw_confidence.description: Uncalibrated raw softmax probability from Stage B classifier

contradiction_type.description: Specific discrepancy taxonomy (§20.1); required when label is DISCREPANCY, null otherwise

normalized_code_agreement.description: True if claim code matches evidence code; null if either lacks a resolvable standard code

rationale.description: Natural language justification from LLM Judge; populated ONLY when stage_reached is C

evidence_id.description: Foreign key to Evidence; must match claim.evidence_id

escalated.description: True if Stage B escalated this claim to Stage C (due to disagreement or low confidence)
